content.description: Illustration showing application of Primer M to the body contact surface around windshield opening using an applicator bottle

content.text: 2. COAT CONTACT SURFACE OF BODY WITH PRIMER "M"
Using a brush, coat the contact surface of the body with Primer M.

Let the primer coating dry for 10 minutes or more. Make sure that the installation of the glass is finished within 2 hours.
● Use care not to leave any part of the coated surface uncoated or excessively coated, as Primer M and G serve to boost the adhesive power of urethane to glass or body.
● Do not keep any of the opened Primer M and G for later use.

content.description: Illustration showing application of Primer G to the edge and contact surface of the windshield glass using an applicator

content.text: 3. COAT CONTACT SURFACE OF GLASS WITH PRIMER "G"

items: (a) Using a brush or sponge, coat the edge of the glass and the contact surface with Primer G.
(b) Before the primer dries, wipe any excess off with a clean cloth to avoid too thick a coat.

content.description: Illustration showing hands mixing adhesive coating by thoroughly cleaning a glass plate or putty spatula with solvent

content.text:
Be sure that installation of the glass is finished within usable time. (See step 2 on page BO-22)
● Mixture should be made in 5 minutes or less.

items: (a) Thoroughly clean a glass plate or such and putty spatula with solvent.
(b) Thoroughly mix the main agent 500g (17.64 oz.) and hardening 75g (2.65 oz.) on the glass plate or such with a putty spatula.

content.description: Illustration showing hands applying adhesive from a cartridge gun with measurements indicating proper bead height and width

items: (a) Cut off the tip of the cartridge nozzle to make a hole 5 mm (0.20 in.) in diameter. Fill the cartridge with adhesive.
(b) Load the cartridge into the sealer gun.
(c) Coat the glass with adhesive on all contact surfaces along the ridge.

content.text:
Adhesive remains on body: 3.5 – 5.0 mm
(0.138 – 0.197 in.)

If no adhesive remains on body: 8 – 10 mm
(0.31 – 0.40 in.)

content.description: Illustration showing installation of windshield glass with reference marks aligned and using a spatula to apply and remove excess adhesive on the glass rim

items: (a) Position the glass so that reference marks are lined up and press in gently along the rim.
(b) Using a spatula, apply adhesive on the glass rim.
(c) Use a spatula to remove any excess or protruding adhesive.
(d) Fasten glass securely until the adhesive sets.
